# braintrust_api_key (Data Source)

Looks up Braintrust API key metadata by ID. The raw key is available only at creation and cannot be retrieved by this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# This lookup returns metadata only, never the raw API key.
data "braintrust_api_key" "existing" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
}

output "api_key_owner" {
  value = data.braintrust_api_key.existing.user_email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the API key (UUID).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of API key creation.
- `expires_at` (String) Actual expiration timestamp. Null when the key does not expire.
- `name` (String) Name of the API key.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID of the API key.
- `preview_name` (String) Masked preview of the API key.
- `user_email` (String) Email of the user who owns the API key.
- `user_family_name` (String) Family name of the user who owns the API key.
- `user_given_name` (String) Given name of the user who owns the API key.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user who owns the API key.
